notes.title: Beta Update (0.9.9.9)
notes.content:
Probably the last major beta version before release: 

	New:
	- [b]Clock [/b]object: CV time signal from BPM/Freq cycle. Sync various sample loops to a certain tempo.
	- UI : [b]Object scaling[/b] : Change object scale or shrink/expand object group within by scaling a [b]Tray[/b]. 
	- UI : [b]Tray naming[/b].
	- UI : top bar to display time&date of last save, project (file)name and cpu/gpu load meters.
	         (also to protect macOS users from hitting annoying macOS menu bar)   
		
	Bug fixes:
	- Output limiter now functional in audio render. 
	- Various fixes on UI control. 
	- Various fixes on Roll syncronization. 
	- Preview picture on project load is now always shown. 


	Changes:
	- Hold object's millisecond mode minimum delay now 1ms.
	  (like for delaying synth's envelope trigger(s) so that frequency can be fully calculated from multiple objects beforehand)

- UI : [b]Object scaling[/b] : Change object scale or shrink/expand object group within by scaling a [b]Tray[/b].
- UI : top bar to display time&date of last save, project (file)name and cpu/gpu load meters.

- Preview picture on project load is now always shown.

notes.title: Beta Update 0.9.9.8
notes.content:
New:
[list]
[*] 	New Object: Format Filter with currently only English Vowel set. 
[*] 	New (redesigned) Object:  Model, physically modeled vibrating string object.
[*] 	Keyboard (F1-F3, arrows, AWSD and space/enter/return) control to top-down menus. 
[*] 	Reverb tuning editor: Create your own reverb by configuring the components and resonances.
[*] 	All Sequencer Objects: New grid/resolution/quantization modes for exotic time signatures. 
[*] 	Roll & Plot : Mouseover information about time position and it's value.
[/list]

After so many user-requested new features, the beta period is now expanded with a month.

Reverb tuning editor: Create your own reverb by configuring the components and resonances.
All Sequencer Objects: New grid/resolution/quantization modes for exotic time signatures.
Roll & Plot : Mouseover information about time position and it's value.

notes.title: Beta Update 0.9.9.5
notes.content:
[b]New added features:[/b]
	- "Modeless" tool change mode with mouseover only (Control settings)
	        [i]This will make the tool panel to disappear. [/i]
		[i]Double click to a parameter will open the value typing interface[/i]

	- Time tap with spacebar to set Pulse/Hold/Delay object's rate, tempo or frequency. 
	- Two new color UI themes. 

	[b]Bug fixes:[/b]
	- Pulse object's mode change between Frequency and BPM will keep the rate as same.

	[b]Changes:[/b]
	- State Machine state names can now be a bit longer (21 characters max)
